question: Can validator semantics be durably pinned across restart while leaving the retained authority-ended durable-token-state-v2 JSON shape unchanged?
baseline: Process-memory validator injection is expected to permit silent validator drift across reopen because the retained token-state file stores only schema+entries.
candidate: Separate atomically persisted validator sidecar with exact validator_id+validator_sha256. Sidecar must exist and match before loading an existing token-state file. New initialization persists sidecar before creating token state. Exact retained durable-token persistence/recover/consume semantics remain unchanged; issue uses the pinned validator callable.
cases: baseline unpinned v2-to-v1 validator drift succeeds and is retained as failure
matching v2 pin restart recovers pending
v2 ledger reopened with v1 validator rejects
same validator id with different sha rejects
existing token state without sidecar rejects
token-state top-level shape remains exactly schema+entries and schema string remains authority-ended-durable-token-state-v2
separate v1 pin issues one-capture receipt
v1 ledger reopened with v2 validator rejects
consume then matching restart remains consumed
sidecar-only crash state is recoverable only through explicit initialize=true with same validator and never permits mismatched validator
hard_gate: RETAIN_VALIDATOR_PIN_CANDIDATE only if baseline drift is reproduced, all 12+ candidate gates pass, mismatches/corruption fail before receipt issuance, and token-state JSON shape is unchanged.
scope: offline single-writer local filesystem; no GUI/model/network/durable-submit transport; two-capture validator is a semantic test contract, not PR #168 formal-source certification
